finalFindingSet.title: Co-op players can damage each other during normal combat
finalFindingSet.trigger: Two arena members enter combat range and one attacks the other with normal player combat.
finalFindingSet.expected: Players in the same cooperative offense session should not damage one another unless friendly fire is an authored mechanic.
finalFindingSet.observed: The player entity keeps normal attack/damage behavior and the selected artifact contains no arena/team friendly-fire cancellation or same-session damage guard. The custom damage sensor only intercepts fatal/knockdown behavior; it does not reject damage from another session member.
finalFindingSet.playerImpact: A teammate can intentionally or accidentally knock down another teammate, consume revive time, add deaths, and disrupt progression.
finalFindingSet.affectedScope: All multi-player sessions in Fall of the Pillager Level 1.

evidence.claim: Normal player component group retains minecraft:attack damage and damage_sensor has no teammate/source exclusion.
Session ownership/team logic exists, but no before-damage cancellation or friendly-fire guard is installed for member-vs-member attacks.

finalFindingSet.proofMethod: Formal Absence Proof + Player Capability/Combat Ownership crosscheck
reproduction: Join the same arena with at least two players.
Have Player A attack Player B with the normal weapon.
Observe Player B receives combat damage and can enter the knockdown/death lifecycle from teammate damage.
finalFindingSet.recommendedResolution: Block damage when attacker and victim are player members of the same cooperative arena/session. Preserve hostile NPC damage and the existing knockdown/revive lifecycle.

suppressed.reason: Current isReviving explicitly rejects reviver.id === downedPlayer.id and requires a sneaking non-knocked-down arena member.
Current SwordRegistry/afterStrike path remembers locked swords and restores a missing remembered sword after combat interaction.
Equipment upgrade paths refund coins when replacement fails; configured enchant names resolve through the current parser.
No additional source-proven reset/reconnect contradiction retained.
No additional publishable residual-state contradiction retained with complete Evidence Receipt.
Admin role is explicitly tag-gated and no ordinary-player developer acquisition path was retained.

closure.note: One source-proven gameplay bug retained. Runtime testing can still reveal additional defects.
